sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.6525 Of 2024
Order:

This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...to issue a writ order or direction more particularly one in the nature of WRIT OF MANDAMUS to declare the action of the respondents in not considering the representation of the petitioners dated 21 11 2022 for enhancement of compensation to the petitioners in pursuance of the judgment passed in LAAS No 137 of 2015 dated 14 09 2022 as per the 28A of the Land Acquisition Act 1894 as well as Act 30 of 2013 as illegal arbitrary null and void and consequently direct the respondents to extend the benefit of the judgement passed in LAAS No 137 of 2015 dated 14 09 2022 to the petitioners..."
2. Heard Learned Counsel appearing for the petitioners and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition.
With the consent of both sides, this writ petition is disposed of at the stage of admission itself.

3. Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition submits that the respondents will consider the representation dated 21.11.2022 filed by the petitioners and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.

In view of the submissions made by the both sides, without going into the merits of the case, the present writ petition is disposed of directing the respondent No.2 to consider the representation filed by the petitioners on 21.11.2022 in pursuance of the Judgment passed in L.A.A.S.No.137 of 2015, dated 14.09.2022 within three (03) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
5. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.

JUSTICE K.SARATH Date: 13.03.2024 spk Banala Lalamma vs The State Of Telangana on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142726789/
